assessment_summary: The inequality replacing λ_f(n)^2 by n^{2ε} inside a sum weighted by χ(n) is invalid when χ(n)=-1, because multiplying by a negative value reverses the comparison. Equality of the coefficients up to X only forces λ_f(n)=0 when χ(n)=-1; it does not make χ(n) nonnegative, contrary to line 0158. Thus the bound in (13), and hence the conclusion, is not justified.
